exceptions.title: No approved consensus backend pinned; multi-member HA unproven
exceptions.rationale: Backend selection and approval is an owner decision; no simulated evidence is produced.
exceptions.compensating_control: Single-member topology only, fsync WAL, verified backups, ExternalBackendContract fails closed.

exceptions.title: MASTER.md absent; deprecation proposed (ADR-007)
exceptions.compensating_control: Normative content carried by ARCHITECTURE/REQUIREMENTS/INTERFACES/ADRs; CI rejects claims that MASTER.md is present.

exceptions.title: pk_core release not pinned or available
exceptions.rationale: Framework not supplied with the archive.
exceptions.compensating_control: Stdlib suite (>200 tests) + CI gate + conformance runner provide executable evidence; framework tests are the only skips and are reported as such.

exceptions.title: No executable environments for INV-04/INV-07/PLN-03 or a real backend
exceptions.rationale: Adjacent layers are not part of this archive.
exceptions.compensating_control: Protocol-level integration via HTTP e2e tests, replication contract tests, conformance vectors any implementation can run.

exceptions.title: Benchmark evidence is from the build sandbox, not production hardware; dashboards not yet imported into a live Grafana
exceptions.compensating_control: Deterministic bench harness + JSON reports; dashboards/alerts shipped as code.

exceptions.title: Owner/security/operations role holders are proposed, not confirmed; ADRs are Proposed
exceptions.compensating_control: Roles and ADRs drafted; release gate reports them as open.

exceptions.title: Outbound LICENSE not selected
exceptions.compensating_control: NOTICE + THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES present; SBOM lists dependency licences.

exceptions.title: Release signing uses HMAC with an owner-provided key; no Sigstore/KMS signing identity configured
exceptions.rationale: Signing identity is an owner/infra decision.
exceptions.compensating_control: Evidence manifest and SLSA-style provenance generated and HMAC-signed when INV05_SIGNING_KEY is set; unsigned evidence blocks promotion.

exceptions.title: requirements.lock has exact versions but no --hash lines
exceptions.rationale: No package-index access in the build sandbox.
exceptions.compensating_control: CI installs with --require-hashes and fails closed until hashes are generated; SBOM lists exact versions.
